en.headline: Around the Island Race sets sail Saturday with 1,500 sailors
en.dek: The Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club event sends fleets on a 45-kilometre circumnavigation of Hong Kong Island in pursuit format.
body: The Sun Hung Kai & Co Around the Island Race returns to Victoria Harbour on Saturday, organised by the Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club.
About 1,500 sailors from more than 200 teams are expected to complete the traditional course around Hong Kong Island. Commissioner for Sports Polly Chong is scheduled to officiate the start.

Club commodore David Norton said several Asian Games medallists from Hong Kong’s sailing and windsurfing teams are entered, and forecast winds of up to 20 knots could favour record attempts in some classes.

zh.headline: 環島帆船賽周六開賽 約1500名水手參與
zh.dek: 皇家香港遊艇會主辦的賽事以追逐形式，讓各組別完成約45公里環繞香港島航程。
body: 新鴻基公司環島賽周六重返維多利亞港，由皇家香港遊艇會主辦。
預計超過200隊、約1500名水手將完成傳統的環繞香港島航程。體育專員鍾文婷將主持起步儀式。
會方表示，香港帆船及滑浪風帆隊多位亞運獎牌得主將參賽，預報風力可達20節，有利部分級別嘗試破紀錄。
